info.title: Docmon
info.description: Docmon is a keyboard-driven, multi-pane terminal UI for managing and monitoring a local Docker stack: containers, live metrics, image-update checks, lifecycle control, exec, file transfer, and an interactive shell. Runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS. This is a v0.1.1 alpha release and is subject to change.
